content:
The HWPX generation failed because the required severity string 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the XML section files.
The run failed with an AssertionError in test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present within /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the verifier could not find the string 'High (즉시조치)' in the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While the HWPX structure was partially created, the mapping of '위험등급' to its formatted severity label in the XML body was incorrect or missing.
